actions.action: Reconcile release mapping and protected deployment provenance
actions.remediation: Establish accepted exact staging/serving/backend version and isolated configuration; reconcile historical instructions, workflow provenance, artifact allowlist and protected operator/recovery authority.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.

actions.action: Verify protected jobs, queue lifecycle and actual outcomes
actions.remediation: Complete actual scheduler-to-HTTP/Edge/business correlation, queue concurrency/retry/terminal and recipient/egress checks, automatic rate/history integrity and safe cleanup on controlled fixtures.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.

actions.action: Establish measurable monitoring, support and incident response
actions.remediation: Approve service/usage scopes, budgets, alert destinations, cadence, private logs and accountable responder/alternate; demonstrate safe detection/receipt and support/incident operation.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.

actions.action: Complete protected backup and full-service recovery evidence
actions.remediation: Resolve private component/file/settings/key coverage, offsite/retention and failure handling; prove independent access and realistic fresh isolated recovery against accepted RPO/RTO without rerunning the committed local restore.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.

actions.action: Prepare and exercise compatible containment and rollback
actions.remediation: Separate product-specific web rollback, scheduler containment, Edge/config and schema/data/security recovery; review exact installed compatibility and preserve history/access controls during accepted operator exercises.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.

actions.action: Reconcile all final dependencies before release disposition
actions.remediation: Complete earlier remediation/installed/device/store evidence and all original coverage/action traceability; prepare accountable release/rollback/incident disposition and perform a fresh full final audit.
actions.prerequisites: Applicable accepted OP decisions, exact staging source/installed mapping, recoverable fixtures/operators and earlier implementation/acceptance dependencies.
